scope: Independent compiler and pipeline checks on Frosty's packaged global compute shader 219. Neither reference shader was dispatched.

related_direct_lighting_entries.result: Running the same frontends on these four LumenSceneDirectLightingHardwareRayTracingCS variants gave four clean LLVM disassemblies, four SPIR-V validation passes, four complete xcl translations and four DXC compilation passes. Each variant contains a buffer_atomic_or instruction.

steps: For this input SHA, inflate the zlib stream at byte 1104 of 219.dxbc into work/fssm/cs_219.fssm. Its 6084 bytes have SHA-256 d274e9a4362ce948b809cf5f5f51f38570d675b530cb650f3bf51bc3ea794256.
leonida.fssm_code_range: [0x168, 0x1508), 967 instructions, zero invalid words and two image_bvh64_intersect_ray instructions. The two earlier 12-byte v_nop markers in xcl's count precede this range.

spirv.abi: 144-byte push constants, physical storage buffer addresses, set 0 image array, sampler array and descriptor lookup buffer. The compiler identifies four 32-bit table pointers in s4 through s7.

leonida.negative_control: Replace only the first image_bvh64_intersect_ray mnemonic in the decoded listing with tux_unknown_bvh, keeping the encodings and FSSM the same. The tool reported 0 translated, named the unknown opcode, and emitted no .spv.
leonida.limits: The reference models triangle results with a normalized denominator. TuxBox's native RDNA2 comparisons check each raw result word. The reference Vulkan compute test lacks shader 219's set 0 descriptor layout and resources.

steps: Build xcl at the pinned revision and set XCL_DXC_DIR to a directory containing dxcompiler.dll. The test DLL had SHA-256 5888d3e590f5bfd8743484e7f31313996734adec5741506271a5c6368cbe8ba9.
Place only 219.dxbc in a separate directory, set XCL_DXIL_CACHE to an empty output directory and run xcl.exe shaders <input-directory> --precompile.
xcl.result: One wave32 compute program, 969 decoded instructions, zero undecoded dwords, zero missing instructions and zero translation errors. DXC compiled 221895 bytes of HLSL for cs_6_6.

pipeline_check.host: GeForce RTX 4070 Ti SUPER (10de:2705), Proton Experimental 1793301796, vkd3d-proton cae2e003bb82516
pipeline_check.procedure: On the same ID3D12Device, use the cached DXIL unchanged as CS in CreateComputePipelineState. Change only pRootSignature between the two calls.
pipeline_check.packaged_root: CreateRootSignature on the original 219.dxbc succeeded. The xcl compute pipeline returned E_INVALIDARG (0x80070057). A separately compiled cs_6_5 shader writing a single u0 buffer created its pipeline successfully with the same root.
pipeline_check.reference_abi_root: Three root UAVs at u0 through u2, four static point/clamp samplers at s0 through s3 in space1, CBV_SRV_UAV_HEAP_DIRECTLY_INDEXED and SAMPLER_HEAP_DIRECTLY_INDEXED. Both root and xcl compute pipeline creation returned S_OK.

xcl.limits: xcl counts unsupported instructions and emits comments for them. The measured missing list for this shader was empty. Its guest-memory windows and texture bindings require runtime setup. Its triangle helper handles TRI0 and TRI1 vertex selection and uses host floating-point intersection arithmetic.
